title: Mapping-Class-Group Presentations of Surface Steinberg Modules
statement: Understand the $\operatorname{Mod}(\Sigma_g^1)$-module structure of the Steinberg module $\operatorname{St}(\Sigma_g^1)$, and give a presentation based on its single module generator.
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Arithmetic Groups vs. Mapping Class Groups: Similarities, Analogies and Differences (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/30, pp. 1637--1708](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/30)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** Broaddus established a finite multi-generator presentation and a cyclic generator, but the requested general presentation based on the single generator is not supplied by the cited work; only low-genus cases are explicitly converted.

**Sources checked.**

- [original Oberwolfach report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/30)
